description_en: Queries the prefix route history for an Express Connect Router (ECR)
description_zh: 查询专线网关ECR（Express Connect Router）前缀路由的历史记录
kebab_example: aliyun expressconnectrouter describe-express-connect-router-allowed-prefix-history --ecr-id ecr-mezk2idmsd0vx20000 --instance-id vbr-j6cwxhgg0s5nuephp0000 --instance-type VPC --dry-run true --client-token FF9nMec/RZ6H9oqFn1pvyir/SLRlxCCyHJonbGzqL01hiM6Jb3wJowdHvjCfog7ww1b9rSHMRFJnrUBfVba68TJg== --association-id ecr-assoc-9p2qxx5phpca2m0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeExpressConnectRouterAllowedPrefixHistory

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Express Connect Router (ECR) instance
parameters.name: ecr_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the network instance that is associated with the ECR.

Specify either the InstanceId or AssociationId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关加载的实例ID。

InstanceId参数和AssociationId参数必须输入一个
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network instance. Valid values:

VPC: A virtual private cloud (VPC) instance.

TR: A transit router (TR) instance
parameters.help_zh:
网络实例的类型。取值：
VPC：虚拟专有网络实例。
TR：转发路由器实例
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:

true: The system runs a check request. It does not modify any resources.

false (default): The system sends a normal request
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：

true：发送检查请求，不会修改服务资源。

false（默认值）：发送正常请求
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en:
A client token to ensure that the request is idempotent.

Generate a unique client-side value to ensure that the request is idempotent. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses the RequestId as the ClientToken. The RequestId is unique for each request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the association between the ECR and the VPC or transit router.

Specify either the InstanceId or AssociationId parameter
parameters.help_zh:
专线网关与专有网络VPC或转发路由器TR的关联的实例ID。

InstanceId参数和AssociationId参数必须输入一个
parameters.name: association_id
